Subject: SOC 2 Type II access request — minimal bundle & bridge window

Hi Lila —

Thanks again for taking the time today. To keep procurement moving on your side, can you share a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or confirm if you prefer a bridge letter + artifact bundle)? To help your security team triage quickly, our standard asks below are intentionally minimal — we can expand if your auditors need more.

Quick asks (preferred order):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or signed bridge letter if report not yet available
- Evidence manifest (CSV) describing folders/files and short descriptions (I attached a template)
- Three representative log samples or a short telemetry snapshot (redacted ok)
- Policy snapshots (access control, incident response, retention) — PDF/screenshots

Preferred transfer methods: presigned S3 link or secure Drive share. If you need SFTP, we can provide instructions.

Audit period clarity: our expected covered window is 2025-04-01 through 2026-03-31. If your compliance team needs a different window for comparability, tell us which dates you require.

I attached: redwood_soc2_bridge_letter_sample.docx (example bridge letter), evidence_manifest_template.csv, presigned_upload_instructions.pdf.

If helpful, here are two one-line reply templates your team can use to delegate the ask quickly:
1) "We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter) and a manifest by EOD 2026-09-13 — please share secure-upload details."
2) "We need to confirm audit period; can Redwood confirm the exact dates required for procurement signoff?"

Next steps: If you confirm preferred transfer method and timeline (EOD 9/13 or earlier), we’ll route to our security ops and get you a presigned link.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber

Confirming audit period requested: 2025-04-01 through 2026-03-31 (this is the reporting window for our latest Type II). If you need a different window for comparison let me know the start/end and we’ll check coverage.

Uploading: see presigned_upload_instructions.pdf (attached). We will send a presigned S3 bundle link when you confirm the preferred S3 bucket prefix; otherwise you can upload to Drive.
